'''Davith Elso''' was a [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-[[Force-sensitive/Legends|sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who worked as a [[Spy/Legends|intelligence operative]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. He made use of a [[Color/Legends|green-bladed]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and was an expert in stealth. At some point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], he joined fellow spy, [[Murne Rin/Legends|Murne Rin]] on a mission to [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]]. He went by the codename "Hawkbat" while on missions.<ref name="Bespin Gambit" />
